about: One recipe per kind of job. scripts/run.py start --recipe <id> opens its checklist; pb.py catalog <id> shows every flow, part, script and QC filter it uses. Each step names the flow or part that does it.

reply.title: Reply run: answer everyone waiting on every platform
reply.when: reply to everyone; a reply run; answer comments

steps.text: Read flows ground-rules and pacing; run audit.py today against the caps
X @acmenotes_demo: every reply from the last 2 days answered or skipped with a reason
Bluesky: bsky_open.py acmenotes.example; every thread handled
Reddit: open questions in the account's subs answered where the app fits
Every reply logged and checked live
Report: counts per platform, skips with reasons, QC warnings

round.title: Growth round: replies, one original per platform, close
round.when: do a round; posting and responding run

steps.text: Ground rules read; caps checked
Reply pass on X, Bluesky and Reddit
One original on X from the post bank
run.py finish; the report lists skips and warnings

post.title: An original post on X and Bluesky

steps.text: Ground rules read; audit.py today against the caps
A post picked from the bank, or written fresh
Every claim traced to a source read this session
qc.py check passed for each platform's version
audit.py gap says READY right before each send
Posted on X
Rewritten for Bluesky and posted
Each post checked live
Each post logged with its link
Report: links, skips, QC warnings

news-share.title: Share a news finding in the owner's voice

steps.text: Ground rules read
The original source read this session (URL), not a summary of it
A finding or a trend in the owner's voice, never another company's ad
qc.py check --recipe news-share passed
audit.py gap says READY
Posted with one link, the source
Checked live
Logged with its link

release.title: Announce a release of the owner's app
release.when: promote a release; announce a version

steps.text: Release notes read; the changes a user would notice listed
Real screenshots of the changed screens
One fresh post per platform, each QC'd and logged

banner.title: A banner, card or other art
banner.when: make a banner; social preview; key art

steps.text: Method picked by the job
Image checks passed at full size
Filed with its prompt or source

lesson.title: Put a lesson into the playbook
lesson.when: the owner corrects something; a new rule; something broke

steps.text: The piece that owns the lesson picked
Saved through the canvas or pb.py put
pb.py check --strict exits 0

onboard.title: Set up a new machine or a new owner
onboard.when: set up on a new machine; first run

steps.text: doctor.py passes
The owner's accounts and folders registered
pb.py check --strict exits 0
